privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.subtitle: PII scanning, data protection policies, and privacy compliance

privacy.policy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.policy.subtitle: What happens to each kind of sensitive value when text leaves EYAS for a remote model.
privacy.policy.enabledHint: Off: nothing is detected, masked or refused.
privacy.policy.saved: Privacy policy saved. It applies from the next model call.
privacy.policy.saveFailed: The policy was not saved. Check the marked fields.
privacy.policy.source.yaml: Imported from config/personality/privacy.yaml. The file is re-imported whenever it changes, until you save the policy here.
privacy.policy.source.ui: Managed on this page. Changes to privacy.yaml are ignored.
privacy.policy.source.defaults: Built-in defaults: privacy.yaml could not be read.
privacy.policy.readOnly: You can view the policy. Only the owner can change it or use the scan tester.
privacy.policy.loadFailed: The privacy policy could not be loaded.
privacy.action.warn.hint: Counted and logged; the text is left as it is.
privacy.action.mask.hint: Replaced with a placeholder such as [EMAIL] when the text goes to a remote model.
privacy.action.block.hint: Masked the same way; a new chat or channel message carrying it is refused before it is stored.
privacy.types.title: Action per type
privacy.type.phone.hint: International numbers starting with +, numbers with an area code in parentheses, the Hungarian national format, or a number next to a phone word.
privacy.type.iban.hint: IBANs of every country, checked with the mod-97 checksum.
privacy.type.bank_account.hint: Hungarian giro account numbers (8-8 or 8-8-8 digits) with a valid checksum.
privacy.type.credit_card.hint: 13–19 digit card numbers with a card-network prefix, checked with Luhn.
privacy.type.personal_id.hint: Hungarian personal ID card numbers (6 digits + 2 capital letters).
privacy.type.tax_number.hint: Hungarian tax numbers, Hungarian EU VAT numbers (HU…) and personal tax IDs next to a tax word.
privacy.type.taj_number.hint: Hungarian TAJ numbers with a valid check digit.
privacy.type.custom.hint: Your own regular expressions, matched one line at a time. The type in capitals becomes the placeholder, e.g. [PROJECT_CODE]; patterns sharing a type use the first pattern's action.
privacy.custom.title: Custom patterns
privacy.custom.name: Name
privacy.localHosts.title: Local hosts
privacy.localHosts.hint: Model endpoints on these hosts receive text unmasked, like localhost. Hostnames or IP addresses only — no scheme, port or path.
privacy.localHosts.invalid: Enter a hostname or IP address without scheme, port or path.
privacy.localHosts.empty: No local hosts besides this machine.
privacy.audit.label: Audit
privacy.audit.hint: Record every model call or memory tool result with masked or warned values in the audit log (types and counts, never the values).
privacy.error.unsafeRegex: This regular expression could hang the scanner (catastrophic backtracking). Simplify it.
privacy.error.invalidRegex: This regular expression is not valid.
privacy.error.invalidHost: Not a hostname or IP address.
privacy.error.invalidType: Use lower-case letters, digits and _, starting with a letter.
privacy.error.invalid: The policy contains an invalid value.
privacy.test.refused: A new message with this text would be refused: {{types}}.
privacy.test.allowed: A new message with this text would be accepted.
